# Benefits

`features/benefits` &middot; section-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

A heading and a checklist of benefits, with an optional image beside it and a button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | listItems |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Benefits on the left, image on the right.
- **image-left**: Image on the left, benefits on the right. Sets `imagePosition: left`, `split: 45/55`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `right`, `left` | `"right"` |
| `split` | text | `"55/45"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row with an image. Check marks are text glyphs. | Stacking works. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/benefits', {
  "heading": "Made to last",
  "intro": "Every piece is built to be worn for years, not seasons.",
  "items": [
    "Organic cotton and European linen",
    "Pre-washed so it fits the same after washing",
    "Free repairs for life",
    "Made in a family-run workshop in Portugal"
  ],
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/480x520/png?text=Workshop",
    "alt": "A tailor stitching a linen shirt at a workshop bench"
  },
  "cta": {
    "label": "Read our story",
    "href": "https://example.com/pages/about"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):
